summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of FlowRoll-Web jiu-jitsu training app via Playwright on the public preview URL. Verified all 6 screens (Dashboard, Library, SituationView, Lesson, Logger, Progress), all data-testids requested in the review, navbar navigation, position grid, scenario list, lesson video element + key sections, lesson prev/next, logger form validation + add/finish session flow, localStorage persistence across reloads, weakness alert recomputation, Continue Training routing to weakest position, and Progress empty state. 14/14 test assertions passed. No console errors, no page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Lesson.jsx logic for `submission` in Logger.jsx handleAdd is redundant — both Win and Loss branches do the same thing; could simplify to a single ternary.

storage.js weakest selection prefers any position with total>=2; with sparse data this is reasonable but could surface false positives at very low sample sizes. Consider gating by total>=3 once data is sufficient.

Dashboard `pickTodaysFocus` resolves weakest by name->position lookup; if a STARTING_POSITIONS entry is renamed and not synced to POSITIONS this would silently fall back. Currently fine since they share names, but worth a unit test.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 3 rounds in localStorage during test (2 Closed Guard losses, 1 Mount win) then cleared at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is purely client-side (no backend). Public URL: https://guard-mastery.preview.emergentagent.com. Uses localStorage keys flowroll.rounds.v1 and flowroll.sessions.v1. All requested data-testids exist. Sample video is Big Buck Bunny mp4 from googleapis. Add Round / Finish Session buttons correctly disabled until valid. Weakness alert switches once a position has >=2 rounds and highest loss rate.
